We started treatment with this doctor after 4 years of marriage. We underwent around 3 months of infertility treatment and after consistent follow-ups, we finally conceived. Unfortunately, at around 1.5 months we came to know that the baby was not growing, and we had to go through a very difficult loss. After taking a short break, we were blessed to conceive naturally.

During the next pregnancy, we faced multiple complications including gestational diabetes, low placenta placement, and bleeding in the 5th month. Throughout this challenging journey, the doctor was knowledgeable, supportive, and gave us confidence. Our due date was in January, but towards the end of pregnancy, due to diabetes-related concerns, we were advised for an early C-section and were blessed with our baby girl on 30th December 2023.

Again, we got good news in 2025. This pregnancy was comparatively smoother, but because of our previous pregnancy history and diabetes concerns, a similar situation was created again even before 35 weeks, and we were advised to prepare for an early delivery. Thankfully, we were blessed with our second baby girl.

Overall, the doctor is friendly, experienced, and knowledgeable, and we are grateful for the care that helped us become parents of two beautiful daughters.

However, one area where we felt improvement is needed is communication during critical decisions. In both pregnancies, the recommendation for C-section came in a very urgent and stressful manner, which left us feeling panicked and with very little time to fully understand, discuss, or mentally prepare for such a major decision. As patients, especially during emotional moments, clearer explanation and more time for discussion would have helped us feel more involved and reassured.

Still, we sincerely appreciate the doctor’s efforts and care throughout our journey and wish the team all the best.

A special thanks to the nursing and support staff, especially Aly, Hema, Sushma, and all the mavashies, for their care, kindness, and support during difficult and emotional moments. Outside India currently and had my wife visit her clinic as she is currently pregnant. She had the most disturbing experience speaking with Dr. Vaishali Ghiya, the primary obstetrician at Carewel.

We had first visited Carewel 3 years ago for our first child. For the delivery, however, I had to take my wife to the hospital at 3 AM and there was no transport available. So we decided to go to the second hospital that we had registered in which was closer to where we live.

featured_reviews.name: Bhagyashri Nikam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was admitted for delivery in Sneh Nursing Home where Dr Aneesh Sabnis treated me. He has a very good experience in handling patients due to which my delivery was smooth and normal. The staff is also very co-operative and takes very good care of the patients admitted. Also proper hygiene is maintained, me and my baby both were taken Care very well.
Just a feedback I would like to give is, there are mosquitoes and there should be more housekeeping staff at night. Apart from these 2 points my experience was wonderful.
This being my first baby I have come with a memory to be cherished for lifetime.
A big thank you from me, my husband and my lil one to each and everyone, the doctors, the nurses, the housekeepers for all the help and support. Thanks 🙂🙂

AND NEITHER DID THEY BOTHER TELLING ME WHETHER I HAVE A GIRL OR A BOY NOR DID THEY BOTHER IN DOING A SKIN TO SKIN TOUCH WITH ME-The Mother.I had to ask the nurse about the gender after all the doctors left.

The pros include the staff is helpful and the clinic is hygienic.
